A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Six3 dosage affects MOE development, and thus the detection of volatile estrus phermones, and that this is critical for the proper migration of GnRH neurons, a key component of fertility.

olfaction and fertility are intimately linked, as both are dependent on the same developmental processes.
